# Q12 quest handlers (theobomos, event_quests, cygnea): generated files

## Phase 6 step 2, lane C (2026-10-11)

The 76 Java handlers of chunk Q12's three directories (`chunks.cmake`) not yet in the tree: theobomos (37), event_quests (31) and cygnea
(8); levels 9-65, many of the event quests at 10. Branch `lane-c/p6-q12`, stacked on `lane-c/p6-butlers`. Method: the earlier chunks'
(questgen's output copied unedited, `AION_QUEST_HANDLER` markers, the golden trace harness, `tools/parity`, the compile check; owner rules
U1/U7), and, because event quests start at npcs of Sanctum and Pandaemonium where gate characters stand, the gate traffic measured
before landing (as for Q11).

| | Files |
|---|---|
| Generated by questgen (bannered, drift-tested) | **72** (theobomos 37, event_quests 27, cygnea 8; 6,643 Java lines) |
| Hand-ported | 0 |
| Not in the tree | **4**: questgen refuses them (below) |
| Held back for a gate | 0 |

### Generator

No change; the corpus stays at 1,006 of 1,035. No Java bug of questgen's list is in the chunk, and none was found.

### Not in the tree (4; reported, not ported)

- `event_quests/_80016EventSockHop`, `_80018EventSockItToEm`: `rewardItems.add(new QuestItems(...))` on the list `onBonusApplyEvent` hands over
  (`api-missing: vector<value:QuestItems>.add`): C++ passes that list read-only, so only a changed hook signature (a header request) would
  admit them.
- `event_quests/_80030EventAnUnwelcomeGaze`, `_80033EventAvertingTheGaze`: `EventService.getInstance()` and `Race.equals` (API gaps).

### Gate traffic

Measured as Q11's was (docs/deviations/Q11.md, "Gate traffic": the temporary client dump in `GameSession::record`, removed afterwards and
never committed) on the seven gates whose characters stand in Sanctum or Pandaemonium (travel, ascension, m5c, m5e, m5e_geo, m5f,
m5f_geo), one at a time under the lock, on this branch with the 72, compared with Q11's runs with Q11 (the only quest-relevant change
between the two trees is Q12; Q05's rest, Q09's rest, Q07 and the butler quests start nowhere near the capitals' gate characters):
**no quest packet differs** (SM_NEARBY_QUESTS, SM_QUEST_ACTION, SM_DIALOG_WINDOW pages, SM_QUEST_LIST, SM_QUEST_COMPLETED_LIST). The
event quests' start npcs add no marker in these runs (why was not traced further; an inactive event is the likely reason).
The only other count differences are one SM_SYSTEM_MESSAGE fewer in ascension, m5e and m5e_geo (fight sessions, which vary between runs;
the same kind of ±1 showed between Q11's two runs). No gate expectation or seeded state was changed.

**Gates**: every gs.scenario.* gate (19), one at a time with the lock taken per gate, m5a_stress excluded, on the full Debug build of
this branch (no dump): **19 of 19 passed** (7,354 s); "Loaded 5052 quest handlers" (4980 + 72); no "QE: exception" line.
